text: To the men feeling emotional about opening their phones every day and seeing man-hating content, I guess congratulations. You know now how it feels for little baby girls to be born into this world, to be surrounded by predators constantly telling them, oh, you're the reason the world is awful. You're there to serve men. You're worth less than a man. Your voice doesn't matter. You don't get to follow your dreams. You get to just be used like cattle to make slaves for this capitalism system that men at the top have created. Congratulations, you know what it's like to be a woman now. So according to her, when men open their phones and see man-hating content, that's finally their chance to experience what it's like to be a woman, and instantly she jumps straight into the apocalypse. Predators everywhere. Your voice doesn't matter. You can't follow your dreams. You exist to serve the system. You are cattle. You are slaves. The irony is almost poetic. She is filming this on a smartphone, speaking freely, posting publicly, getting views, building a platform, choosing her own career, becoming an influencer, living the exact opposite of what she claims women are allowed to do. She is the proof of her own argument falling apart. Miss, you live in the safest, freest, most opportunity-rich era humans, both men and women, have ever experienced. Education, careers, independence, legal protection, social support, it's all there. And that's great. And let me tell you this. Lots of men support women. We have mothers, sisters, girlfriends, and plenty of other women in our lives. Do you really think most men would not support their well-being? But supporting women doesn't require hating men. You can call men and women out on certain behavior, and this is what I do on my channel, but you shouldn't slide into a straight-up hatred and lying. You can't call yourself a slave of capitalism while using capitalist freedoms and capitalist tech to broadcast to millions about how oppressed you are. Calling modern women cattle is an empowerment. It is dramatic and disconnected from reality. If you are genuinely trying to help women, you uplift them. You give them tools. You show strength. You don't sell fear. And you definitely don't pretend that all men are monsters and that the freest generation of women in history is somehow living in chains.
